text:
maria.docs: Quick sync  I'm opening a micro-PR to update the Rate Limits & Quotas page to the new metering headers, refresh dashboard links, and add a short migration checklist. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4510
cheng: ping infra  two things: Grafana moved the panel under /d/usage-insights (panelId=73) and the metric name changed to rate_consume_by_tier. I'll attach the exported panel JSON after I run the export job.
samir: I'll swap out examples that reference X-Rate-Limit. New recommended header: x-rw-metering with values like "usage=150;unit=tokens". Draft minimal snippets incoming (1-liners for quickstart box).
olivia: Add an explicit migration FAQ entry: "Why did my burst behavior change?" Answer: bursts are now allocated per-route and decay over ~1h (was per-minute)  this affects short-lived spikes.
kevin-support: Please also add a short note for Support runbooks: update escalation triggers to use the new dashboard panel and the rate_consume_by_tier metric. We had two customer tickets this week from confusion.
docs-bot: Staging preview: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/rate-limits?pr=4510 
maria.docs: Samir, drop node/python/go 1-line snippets here and I'll paste into the quick examples box. Keep them tiny.
samir: Node: `await client.request('POST','/v1/generate',{headers:{'x-rw-metering':'usage=150;unit=tokens'}})`
Python: `resp = client.generate(..., headers={'x-rw-metering':'usage=150;unit=tokens'})`
Go: `req.Header.Set("x-rw-metering","usage=150;unit=tokens")`
cheng: LGTM from infra; I'll push the panel export and verify panelId=73.
maria.docs: I'll update the checklist at the top: 1) replace header examples with x-rw-metering, 2) update embedded dashboard link to /d/usage-insights?panelId=73, 3) change alert metric to rate_consume_by_tier, 4) add burst-decay FAQ. Merging after CI green unless objections in 30m.
kevin-support: Thanks  that should reduce support churn.
olivia: lgtm.
